notes: Saving a login for Saga now always carries it on: once you save it in Colon Secured Login, Saga signs in at once (close the form and Saga hands the sign-in to you, never a silent wait). While Saga waits for you, your messages get a real reply; say “continue” or “I’ve saved it” to carry on, or “stop”. A login saved for a site also works on its subdomains (yolotask.com.ng for reviewer.yolotask.com.ng), and the waiting card offers the login form again or Stop.

browser.notes: Released alongside Colon AI 0.11.6: a saved login now also matches the site’s subdomains.
